text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: This voice... Who is calling out to me...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This voice calling out... it's not her. It 
feels almost... warm and comforting...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Could you be... the Three Goddesses?
